It builds per-cell hazen 90th-percentile pools of ±5 days, sets day 60 by interpolation, applies a wrapped 31-day smoothing, and compares June–August 2003 SST against the smoothed threshold; the target days use thresholds for day-of-year 138–259, so their pools draw on 12 May–20 Sep of each baseline year. It then runs per-cell run detection and gap joining on sea cells and writes mh to output/mhw_mask.nc; the climatology is never used."}
